description: Implementation of the parallel module class 'Module_p' with methods for calculating resistance, voltages, current redistribution, and time stepping, including thermal and cooling system interactions.

classes.name: Module_p
classes.description: Implementation of a parallel module class managing resistance, voltage, current redistribution, and thermal interactions.

methods.name: getRtot
methods.description: Calculates total resistance of the module considering contact resistances and series resistances of sub-units.

methods.name: getVall
methods.description: Calculates the voltage of each sub-unit considering contact resistances and stores in provided span.

methods.name: redistributeCurrent
methods.description: Iteratively balances the current among sub-units to equalize voltages.

methods.name: setVoltage
methods.description: Adjusts sub-unit currents to achieve a target voltage.

methods.name: setCurrent
methods.description: Sets the total current of the module, adjusting individual sub-unit currents accordingly.

methods.name: timeStep_CC
methods.description: Performs a constant current time step, updating thermal state and managing heat exchange.
